response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack and web software developer with a strong track record in TypeScript, Node.js, and general software craftsmanship, but has no demonstrated experience in SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, GPU/AI accelerator architecture, or deep-learning performance optimization, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, senior-level software engineering experience
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, testing frameworks)
Experience with low-latency, high-performance systems (DLang, async I/O, fibers) at Dunnhumby
concerns: No evidence of SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No background in GPU architecture, SIMD/MIMD, or AI accelerator design

key_factors.factor: No GPU or deep-learning workload optimization background
Strong general software engineering seniority and craftsmanship
